title: Keep your conversations in sync with Quo’s monday CRM integration
summary: If you use monday CRM with your team, find out how your team can set the Quo monday integration up and how it works.
body_markdown:
Your team’s task list is long enough without manually stitching together what’s happening in Quo with all your contacts and conversations in monday CRM. Now with Quo’s monday CRM integration, you can keep all your conversations in sync automatically. Here’s how it works:


##


**Automatically log phone interactions**


Give your team a complete view of every customer relationship. The integration automatically logs calls and texts to the contact’s Emails & Activities feed in monday, alongside call summaries and recording links.


##


**See when a contact calls in**


Easily see who calls when they dial your Quo number. Any incoming call notification shows that saved monday CRM contact’s name.


##


**Keep your contacts up to date**


Update any monday CRM contact’s name in Quo and that will automatically update in your CRM.


##


Get started using the Quo monday CRM integration


[Quo workspace Owners or Admins](https://support.quo.com/core-concepts/administration/members) on the[Business or Scale plan](https://quo.com/pricing) can[connect monday CRM to Quo](https://support.quo.com/monday-crm) now in just a few clicks.
